messages:
Priya N: dropped a new mock for the evals approval strip — trying to keep the primary approve CTA visible in compact rows while keeping the diff metadata readable: https://figma.com/file/compact-approval. want quick a11y + copy thoughts. :eyes: Declan R: looks solid. main flag: when space is tight we currently hide the approve button behind an overflow. that reduces discoverability. recommend always showing a single primary CTA and demoting others. Maeve H: +1. also watch the visual weight: use the brand blue for primary but keep contrast >= 4.5:1 for text on the pill. when compacted the CTA becomes a small icon button — ensure it has an accessible name and tooltip. Priya N: thinking: show primary approve (icon+label) up to 3 results wide, then collapse label to icon only but keep aria-label 'Approve diff'. overflow contains 'Request changes' and 'Add note'. on collapse show "3/14" counter. animation 110ms. Declan R: keyboard users need a predictable tab stop order: metadata -> primary CTA -> overflow. if label collapses, make sure the aria-label is present and focus ring is large enough. Maeve H: add aria-live announcement when actions happen: "Diff 2 approved" and include a polite region. small snippet:
update text on action. Priya N: copy nit: label options: 'Approve', 'Mark correct', 'Accept'. which feels clearest? aiming for non-ambiguous in a review context. Declan R: 'Approve' is crisp and aligns with other workflows. 'Accept' feels vague. Maeve H: agree on 'Approve'. also tooltip text should be simple: 'Approve this diff'. avoid keyboard shortcut mentions in the tooltip itself. accessibility-bot: Accessibility checklist updated: eval-approval-compact -> primary-cta-visible, icon-button-aria-labels, aria-live-on-action, tab-order-defined, contrast-4.5. See /docs/accessibility/eval-approval-compact.md :white_check_mark: Priya N: sweet. follow-ups: @Declan R to write keyboard tab-order tests; @Maeve H to validate color contrast and SR announces on macOS VoiceOver. I'll update the mock and open a small PR behind flag. target: next sprint. :rocket:
